correction_note: Phase 2B claimed WIRED and third_sku_ready for capabilities whose runtime behaviour did not support it; Phase 4 added six dimensions; Phase 6 removed the remaining claims that had no runtime proof. Readiness now requires the capability's real execution output to be produced and verified by the chain.

dimensions.IMPLEMENTED: the capability's logic exists in this repository
dimensions.VALIDATOR_WIRED: a production path calls its validator
dimensions.PRODUCER_DEFINED: its required artifact has exactly one registered producer
dimensions.EXECUTOR_AVAILABLE: an executor ships in this repository (false means a job-specific adapter must be supplied)
dimensions.MANUAL_GATE_DEFINED: the manual or adapter step is explicit in the producer registry or the execution contracts
dimensions.END_TO_END_REACHABLE: the fast path reaches this stage and it can PASS once its declared producers have acted

invariants: wiring_status == WIRED implies production_caller is not null
wiring_status == WIRED implies git_tracked is true
third_sku_ready == true implies END_TO_END_REACHABLE is true
third_sku_ready == true implies EXECUTOR_AVAILABLE is true
third_sku_ready == true implies PRODUCER_DEFINED is true
EXECUTOR_AVAILABLE == false and PRODUCER_DEFINED == true implies MANUAL_GATE_DEFINED is true
every P0 module has a non-null production_caller
stage is one of the eight semantic stages

capabilities.notes: Generic producer contract. Requires a job id, a product identity and a source directory; discovers supported media and assumes no file count and no product. The historical Filter-only initializer (exactly 16 MP4 files, Faucet Filter identity) is kept unchanged for compatibility and is not the Third-SKU contract. Zero discoverable media is a controlled error.
reachable only from job-side builders that live outside version control.

capabilities.capability: placement authoring under the measured timebase
capabilities.notes: every placement must state a measured t_in_seconds; a coordinate derived from frame_index/fps is refused before segmentation runs.

frozen Batch 1 engine, run on the CFR analysis grid. The engine decodes at a forced fps, so analysis frame N is the content at N/fps; the placement window is derived from measured PTS into THAT grid, never from a raw decoded ordinal. Proven against a real VFR source (10 fps then 30 fps): the 1.0 s window maps to analysis frame 30, and the analysed content is the 1.0 s region. KL-01 and KL-02 remain open.
structurally inert in the only run that reached it: group_shapes was {SINGLE: 18} because the caller passed a constant narrative_role, so no ACTION_RESULT unit was produced.
Gate E GAP-08. The SKU#2 artifact's computation field is prose and its generator was never saved.
refuses a cut that enters after observable action onset or exits before the observable result.
COMPILER_STATUS is NOT_IMPLEMENTED for all three backends and compile_for_backend always raises. The fast path does not call it.

capabilities.capability: source-range execution under the timebase invariant
capabilities.notes: P0 and global. SOURCE = measured PTS; ANALYSIS GRID = CFR derived from measured PTS; TIMELINE = CFR. A raw decoded ordinal is never used as an analysis coordinate. assert_range_coverage fails when a declared unit was executed without passing through the adapter.
The fast path consumes and validates measurements through ShotMeasurement, and the measurement producer is a CODEX author because no measurement tool ships here. Reachable but not ready.
Reachable, and the stage runs it. Production exited at UNAVAILABLE 7/7 in the only run that reached it, so the four real tolerance checks have still never executed. Not marked ready for that reason.

KEEP and REVIEW are live-proven; the CORRECT branch has never fired in production. The stage executes the picture and verifies the real artifact, so a decision alone no longer passes. Not marked ready because the measurement it consumes is authored per job: no measurement tool ships in this repository.

Runtime-proven. Job-scoped and local: it joins the ranges the fast path extracted through the timebase adapter and applies each unit’s own explicit geometry (FIT scales and pads; CROP takes an explicit source rectangle and scales it to the output — never inferred, never adjusted, and never silently replaced by a fit), then the stage re-measures the real file (frames, geometry, fps, sha256). No universal engine, no automatic framing, and no DaVinci research reopened.
P0. Runs before any paid voice generation, and the typography stage now renders a real artifact from this job's own layout. The four caller judgements remain required fields.
Gate E GAP-03. The SKU#2 precheck numbers do not reconcile with check_window and no generator was preserved.
the fast path does not yet call it. Known limitation: the historical SKU#1 editorial_text_plan.json is rejected for nine unrelated extra keys. Recorded, deliberately not repaired.

Runtime-proven. Pillow rasterises this job's copy and FFmpeg composites it in one pass. layout and font_stack are required fields: the adapter ships no default layout or font, so one job's art direction cannot become another's. This is not a generic typography system.

P0. No universal sync tolerance; FIT alone is never approval. The stage also mixes and measures a real audio artifact now. Not marked ready because the VO placement it consumes is authored per job: no placement adapter ships.
rejects both Cushion Puff audio artifacts; no audio_plan.v0 document exists in either job. The project's own words: an adoption gap, not a capability gap.

Runtime-proven. Mixes this job's own local assets and measures integrated loudness, true peak and sample peak from the file, with an explicit no-clipping result. The stage fails if the adapter reports clipping or produces no artifact. This is not a universal audio system.

Runtime-proven. Contract published as execution_contracts 'assemble_master'. Produces final/master.mp4, then verification opens the file: it recomputes the sha256, decodes frames, reconciles the count against upstream evidence, detects black frames and freezes, and measures loudness and true peak. A JSON claim can no longer pass — the Phase 5 bypass is closed.

P0. Every dimension judged exactly once; an incomplete review fails closed. A CRITICAL finding is a controlled REJECT, not a repair. The verdict is derived on read, and a reviewer verdict is not a release.
repair scope lock is enforced rather than described. A REJECT review is not passed to repair planning, because the contract refuses to plan one.
a distinct artifact from the review. PRODUCTION_READY from a reviewer produces SUPERVISOR_DECISION_REQUIRED, not a release; the release must name the verdict it answers.
declared NOT_IMPLEMENTED in docs/policies/reviewer-repair.md. The contract records a judgement; it does not produce one.

Artifact intervention_ledger.jsonl is produced automatically (AUTO) by the fast path when a gate halts a run, so the operator is not asked to remember. Append-only and prospective; the SKU#2 baseline stays PARTIALLY_VERIFIED.

full_chain_note: Completable with the four job-scoped adapters that now ship in src/ai_autocut/execution_adapters.py. Each reads this job's own request file and holds no default art direction. The chain is reproducible without a previous conversation; it is still not autonomous, and every gate still stops the run.

runtime_proof.proven: the production control path produced a real master which was then independently re-measured
runtime_proof.note: The sha256 is recorded in the job itself, not here: a hash written into a tracked document would be a claim, and this manifest only records measurements that a reader can reproduce by running the command above.
